answer: Treating the possibility of costless network subversion as a naive fable, the protocol implements zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions paired with quadratic slashing penalties. Consequently, super-linear capital expenditure scaling guarantees that the marginal attack cost strictly exceeds potential extracted value, securing a robust Nash equilibrium.
